d:
Haridwar, one of the holiest cities in India, is where the sacred River Ganga enters the plains after flowing down from the Himalayas. Known as the Gateway to God, Haridwar is famous for its ancient temples, spiritual ashrams, holy ghats, traditional bazaars and the beautiful evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri.
Located in Uttarakhand, Haridwar is a popular destination for pilgrims and travellers alike. It is approximately 220–230 km from Delhi, 55 km from Dehradun and 25 km from Rishikesh (road distances, depending on the route).
